zh.title: 空中巴士第二季交付237架飛機 並維持全年870架目標
zh.summary: 據Simple Flying報導，空中巴士於2026年第二季共交付237架飛機。空中巴士同時維持全年交付870架飛機的目標。報導指出，維持永續的產能提升，對空中巴士達成全年870架交付目標將是關鍵要素。
body: 根據新聞媒體Simple Flying報導，空中巴士在2026年第二季度總共完成了237架飛機的交付作業。
在公布第二季度的交付數據之際，空中巴士依然保持全年總計交付870架飛機的既定目標。
Simple Flying報導分析，空中巴士能否維持永續的產能提升步調，對於其能否順利實現全年度870架飛機的交付目標而言至為關鍵。
保持永續的生產提速步調，將是空中巴士達成全年870架交付目標的要務。

en.title: Airbus Delivers 237 Aircraft In Q2, Maintains Full-Year Target Of 870
en.summary: According to a report published by Simple Flying on July 29, 2026, Airbus achieved 237 aircraft deliveries during the second quarter. In addition to these delivery results, Airbus is keeping its target of 870 deliveries for the full year. Simple Flying reported that maintaining a sustainable production ramp-up will be crucial in order for Airbus to achieve its 870-aircraft delivery target for the full year.
body: According to a news report published by Simple Flying, Airbus achieved a total of 237 aircraft deliveries in the second quarter of 2026.
Along with the second-quarter delivery figures, Airbus confirmed that it is keeping its full-year target of 870 aircraft deliveries.
Simple Flying highlighted that maintaining a sustainable production ramp-up will be a crucial factor for Airbus as it seeks to achieve its delivery target of 870 aircraft for the full year.
The delivery target of 870 aircraft for the full year remains the focus as Airbus works to maintain its sustainable production ramp-up.

zh.title: Somon Air接收首架波音737 MAX 創下塔吉克首例
zh.summary: Somon Air 於 2026 年 8 月 3 日接收首架波音 737-8，創下該機型引進塔吉克的首例。此飛機是向 Dubai Aerospace Enterprise (DAE) 租賃兩架計劃中的第一架，將用於中亞、歐洲及亞洲的短中程航線，並規劃未來服務倫敦與北京等航點。
body: 塔吉克國家航空 Somon Air 已接收其首架波音 737 MAX 噴射客機，這也是 737 MAX 飛機首次在塔吉克共和國引進。波音公司與該航空公司於 2026 年 8 月 3 日共同宣布了此項 737-8 機型的交付，此舉是該航空公司推動機隊現代化並進一步拓展其航線網路策略的重要一步。
此架全新的 737-8 飛機是 Somon Air 向杜拜航太企業 Dubai Aerospace Enterprise (DAE) 租賃兩架飛機計劃中首架交付的客機。該航空公司計劃將此客機部署於往返中亞、歐洲、中東與亞洲的短程及中程航線。憑藉該機型提升的航程與營運經濟效益，Somon Air 計劃利用其開闢新航線，其未來規劃也包括前往倫敦、北京與廣州的航線服務。
目前，Somon Air 以 Dushanbe International Airport 為樞紐，營運著由 6 架 Next-Generation 737 飛機組成的機隊，航點遍及歐洲、亞洲與中東的 29 個目的地。在此次租賃交付之前，波音與 Somon Air 曾於先前宣布一項承諾，該航空公司計劃購買至多 14 架具燃油效率的 787 Dreamliner 及 737 MAX 飛機。
在波音整體的商用飛機交付表現方面，根據波音先前公布的 2026 年第二季財務報告，其商用飛機部門（Commercial Airplanes）在該季度共交付了 171 架飛機。此外，該部門在此期間共獲得了 246 架淨訂單，其中包括來自大韓航空（Korean Air）、達美航空（Delta Air Lines）以及租賃公司 SMBC Capital 的訂單。

en.title: Somon Air Receives Its First Boeing 737 MAX Aircraft in Tajikistan
en.summary: Tajikistan national carrier Somon Air has received its first Boeing 737 MAX, representing the first appearance of this advanced aircraft family in the country. Delivered on August 3, 2026, the Boeing 737-8 is the first of two aircraft leased from Dubai Aerospace Enterprise (DAE). The carrier plans to deploy the fuel-efficient narrowbody jet on its short- and medium-haul routes across Central Asia, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia, with future expansion plans including new services to London, Beijing, and Guangzhou.
body: Tajikistan's national carrier, Somon Air, has officially received its first Boeing 737 MAX jet, marking the historic first appearance of this advanced aircraft family in the country. Boeing and the airline announced the successful delivery of the 737-8 on August 3, 2026, in Dushanbe, representing a significant milestone in the airline's broader strategy to modernize its commercial fleet and expand its global network.

The new 737-8 is the first of two airplanes leased by Somon Air from leasing firm Dubai Aerospace Enterprise (DAE) to be delivered to the carrier. The airline plans to operate this single-aisle aircraft on its short- and medium-haul routes across Central Asia, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia. Its improved range and fuel efficiency will assist Somon Air as it aims to open new routes, with future plans including scheduled services to London, Beijing, and Guangzhou.

Currently, Somon Air operates a fleet of six Next-Generation 737 aircraft to 29 destinations across Europe, Asia, and the Middle East from its main operations hub at Dushanbe International Airport. The delivery of this leased narrowbody follows a prior agreement in which Boeing and Somon Air announced the carrier's commercial commitment to acquire up to 14 fuel-efficient 787 Dreamliner and 737 MAX aircraft.

Looking at Boeing's wider commercial delivery performance, the manufacturer's Commercial Airplanes business unit delivered 171 aircraft during the second quarter of 2026. According to Boeing's official financial reports, the division also booked 246 net commercial aircraft orders during the same three-month period, which included key commitments from global carriers such as Korean Air and Delta Air Lines, as well as leasing corporation SMBC Capital.
